tables_meta.band_dv_note: Excursion safety did not differ meaningfully by band (exp 12); only the delta-V cost did, so all EXCURSE_* actions share one kernel.
tables_meta.caveats: The DRIFT/FAR rows for observe/excurse are engineering judgement anchored on few trials, not tightly measured; they are the least trustworthy numbers here and are the first thing calibration should replace.
tables_meta.provenance: Hand-transcribed from the Python CR3BP+EncJ2 experiment output; NOT yet machine-generated. Superseded once experiments/calibrate.jl runs against the ported Julia dynamics.

sources.correct: exp 11b — sustained MPC loop. Measured OK->OK 0.98; from off-nominal the planner pulls inward.
sources.observe: exp 11b counterfactual (OK survives ~1 skipped pass) + exp 01 uncontrolled decay (dev grows OK->DRIFT->FAR->LOST over ~2-3 skipped passes).
sources.excurse: exp 06/12 — excursion plus its recovery burn. From OK the excursion recovered to dev=OK in 3/3 trials for every band; a small residual risk is retained for robustness. From DRIFT/FAR an added perturbation is riskier, so mass leaks outward faster than CORRECT.
